result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages use a serif with a mono on a warm paper ground, and neither looks like a generic dark-mode template. A gets its mood almost entirely from type: an italic serif title, a small-caps 'Radio', a typewriter-style log line and a mono button that matches the rest. B leans more on decoration (rotated paper, tape, a bevelled gradient button), though its serif-title versus mono-caps-artist split makes the playlist slightly easier to read. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both pages pair a literary serif with a monospace on a cream ground and avoid the usual dark-mode template. B gets its mood more from type alone: an italic title over small-caps 'Radio', a log-style playlist with timestamps, and a flat button set in the page's mono. A leans more on effects (a taped paper card, drop shadows, a beveled gradient button), though its playlist (serif titles over mono uppercase artists) reads very clearly.
